title: iPhone Notification
blurb: Three notes, descending, and every phone in the room gets checked. Apple's tri-tone alert has served as the default text tone since the early iPhone era, making it one of the most thoroughly conditioned reflexes in modern life — people reach for a pocket before they have consciously registered hearing anything. Editors use it to signal an incoming message without ever showing a screen; everyone else uses it as a social experiment. Play it in a quiet carriage, a lecture theatre or an open-plan office and count the heads that snap downwards. The apex predator of prank sounds, and likely to stay that way.
origin: Apple's default alert tone; the most reflexively recognized sound in modern life.
